def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[c] == 5 for row in grid)]
    top, bottom = min(rows), max(rows)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    inner_h, inner_w = bottom - top - 1, right - left - 1
    for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
        for c in range(left + 1, right):
            depth = min(r - top, bottom - r, c - left, right - c)
            if min(inner_h, inner_w) == 7 and depth >= 3:
                continue
            color = {1: 2, 2: 5, 3: 0, 0: 5}[depth % 4]
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
